_about: The vocabularies, shapes and questions as last accepted. `kgctl.py ontology check` compares the files with it; `kgctl.py ontology accept --by <you>` updates it. Generated: do not edit.
accepted_by: claude: report 2.1.0 — history of definitions, aliases, recorded rationale

dt:AuthoringRule.label: Authoring rule
dt:AuthoringRule.definition: Guidance for writing templates that survive real data.

dt:Batch.label: Batch
dt:Batch.definition: A production run: template version, as-of date, list of documents.

dt:Blueprint.label: Blueprint
dt:Blueprint.definition: The semantic model of a page: each region labeled with a component, each text span classified as static or as the source of a named slot, and the repeat structure.

dt:ColorToken.label: Color token
dt:ColorToken.definition: A hex color with a role (brand, ink, rule, band, chart mark).

dt:Component.label: Component
dt:Component.definition: A reusable visual box type (returns table, allocation list, bar chart, key-value list…). One component = one template macro.

dt:DataDocument.label: Data document
dt:DataDocument.definition: One document's data as JSON, conforming to the data schema.

dt:DataGap.label: Data gap
dt:DataGap.definition: A slot whose value could not be filled or parsed; needs a human.

dt:DataSchema.label: Data schema
dt:DataSchema.definition: JSON Schema for one document's data, derived from blueprint slots (types, required, arrays, max lengths).

dt:DesignToken.label: Design token
dt:DesignToken.definition: A named, measured style value (color, font family, size, spacing, rule width) reused across the template.

dt:Drawing.label: Drawing
dt:Drawing.definition: A vector path: rule, box or fill, with stroke color, fill color and width.

dt:FontFile.label: Font file
dt:FontFile.definition: A font embedded in a vector source; usable via @font-face if licensed.

dt:GoldenImage.label: Golden image
dt:GoldenImage.definition: The approved render plus a mask of static regions (regions with no slots), used to detect unintended change in production.

dt:InspectionReport.label: Inspection report
dt:InspectionReport.definition: Per-page kind, fonts, sizes, colors, large images.

dt:IntakeRecord.label: Intake record
dt:IntakeRecord.definition: Source hash, page count, page sizes, encryption.

dt:Layout.label: Layout
dt:Layout.definition: An arrangement of components into columns; templates share components and differ by layout.

dt:OcrWord.label: OCR word
dt:OcrWord.definition: A text span read by OCR from a raster image; adds conf (0–1) and est_size_pt from glyph height.

dt:Page.label: Page
dt:Page.definition: One page of a source document, classified by how its content is encoded.

dt:PageImage.label: Page image
dt:PageImage.definition: A raster of a page at a known dpi; the visual reference every comparison uses.

dt:PageKind.label: Page kind
dt:PageKind.definition: Vector (real text and drawings), Raster (a picture of a page), or Mixed.

dt:PublishReceipt.label: Publish receipt
dt:PublishReceipt.definition: Destination and hash of every published document.

dt:Region.label: Region
dt:Region.definition: A rectangular area of a page that groups text and drawings into one visual box (detected from rules/boxes), with a region_id and bbox.

dt:RegionCrop.label: Region crop
dt:RegionCrop.definition: Side-by-side source|render image of one failing region, given to repair.

dt:RenderedDocument.label: Rendered document
dt:RenderedDocument.definition: HTML, PDF and PNG produced by rendering a data document through a template project with headless Chromium.

dt:RepairRecord.label: Repair record
dt:RepairRecord.definition: What one repair round changed, which failures it targeted, files touched.

dt:ReviewPage.label: Review page
dt:ReviewPage.definition: A self-contained HTML page shown to a human at a gate.

dt:SampleData.label: Sample data
dt:SampleData.definition: The source PDF's own data, filled by code from its text; rendering it must reproduce the source.

dt:Slot.label: Slot
dt:Slot.definition: A named place where data goes, with a type and a repeat flag. Every slot becomes one data-schema field.

dt:SlotType.label: Slot type
dt:SlotType.definition: How a slot's value is parsed and formatted.

dt:SourceDocument.label: Source document
dt:SourceDocument.definition: The sample PDF a template must reproduce. Identified by its sha256.

dt:SpacingToken.label: Spacing token
dt:SpacingToken.definition: Margins, gaps, column x-positions, rule widths.

dt:StaticText.label: Static text
dt:StaticText.definition: Text that is part of the design (labels, headings, disclaimers); it becomes an i18n label, never data.

dt:StressCase.label: Stress case
dt:StressCase.definition: Seeded edge-case data (longest strings, most rows, French, extremes) that the template must survive.

dt:StressResult.label: Stress result
dt:StressResult.definition: Per stress case: overflow, fidelity, visibility.

dt:TemplateProject.label: Template project
dt:TemplateProject.definition: The template folder of one report type: tokens.css, components.j2 (one macro per component), base.html.j2 (page shell), charts.json, layouts.json, i18n.json. It is data only; charts and formatters are the plugin's filters, configured by charts.json.

dt:TemplateRelease.label: Template release
dt:TemplateRelease.definition: A frozen, versioned copy of a template project with a manifest of file hashes and the sign-off approval id.

dt:TextCorrection.label: Text correction
dt:TextCorrection.definition: A human-confirmed value replacing uncertain OCR text or filling a data gap.

dt:TextSpan.label: Text span
dt:TextSpan.definition: A run of text with bbox (points, top-left origin), font, size (pt), color (hex), bold, italic, and a stable span_id.

dt:TypeToken.label: Type token
dt:TypeToken.definition: A font family, weight and size in pt with a role (title, heading, body, footnote).

dt:VerificationResult.label: Verification result
dt:VerificationResult.definition: Per-region results of comparing a render to its reference and its data: overflow, fidelity, visibility, similarity, style.

dt:conformsTo.label: conforms to
dt:conformsTo.definition: The data schema the document's data must satisfy.

dt:derivedFrom.label: derived from
dt:derivedFrom.definition: What the item was computed from: a data schema from the blueprint's slots, sample data from the source's text spans.

dt:hasSlot.label: has slot
dt:hasSlot.definition: A named place for data inside the region.

dt:implementsComponent.label: implements component
dt:implementsComponent.definition: The template project has a macro that draws this component.

dt:inRegion.label: in region
dt:inRegion.definition: The region (visual box) the text span was assigned to.

dt:labeledAs.label: labeled as
dt:labeledAs.definition: The component the blueprint says the region is; every region has exactly one.

dt:onPage.label: on page
dt:onPage.definition: The page a text span, drawing, region or page image is found on.

dt:pageKind.label: page kind
dt:pageKind.definition: How the page's content is encoded: vector, raster or mixed. It decides whether text is measured or read by OCR.

dt:pageOf.label: page of
dt:pageOf.definition: The source document the page belongs to.

dt:renderedFrom.label: rendered from
dt:renderedFrom.definition: The data document and the template project the rendered document was produced from.

dt:slotType.label: slot type
dt:slotType.definition: How the slot's value is parsed and formatted.

dt:sourcedFrom.label: sourced from
dt:sourcedFrom.definition: The text span of the source PDF that holds the slot's sample value. Not the data mapping: that is rpt:sourcedFrom (field → column).

dt:verifies.label: verifies
dt:verifies.definition: The rendered document the verification result is about.

flow:Artifact.label: Artifact
flow:Artifact.definition: A file or folder exchanged between steps, with a path, format and field structure.

flow:Check.label: Check
flow:Check.definition: A deterministic validation run after a step; a blocking failure sets the step's outcome.

flow:ClaudeStep.label: Claude step
flow:ClaudeStep.definition: Claude with a versioned prompt and a required output schema; cached by input hash; never routes.

flow:DeterministicStep.label: Deterministic step
flow:DeterministicStep.definition: A script: same inputs, same outputs.

flow:Effect.label: Effect
flow:Effect.definition: A state mutation applied when a transition is taken (set, increment, reset, append…).

flow:Field.label: Field
flow:Field.definition: A named path inside a structured artifact (e.g. pages[].regions[].bbox).

flow:Flow.label: Flow
flow:Flow.definition: A versioned process graph with entrypoints, phases, steps and transitions.

flow:HumanStep.label: Human step
flow:HumanStep.definition: A person records a decision; the flow pauses until it exists.

flow:Implementation.label: Implementation
flow:Implementation.definition: The script that executes a step.

flow:Invariant.label: Invariant
flow:Invariant.definition: A statement that must always hold; enforced by one or more checks.

flow:Metric.label: Metric
flow:Metric.definition: A named measurement a step records in run state and checks compare against parameters.

flow:OcrStep.label: OCR step
flow:OcrStep.definition: An OCR engine run; output carries per-word confidence.

flow:Outcome.label: Outcome
flow:Outcome.definition: A named result of a step (pass, fail, approve, …); the only thing transitions branch on.

flow:Parameter.label: Parameter
flow:Parameter.definition: A configuration value (threshold, limit, seed) owned by config, never by steps.

flow:Phase.label: Phase
flow:Phase.definition: A named group of steps run together (e.g. template build, production run).

flow:Step.label: Step
flow:Step.definition: A unit of work with declared inputs, outputs, checks and outcomes.

flow:TestObligation.label: Test obligation
flow:TestObligation.definition: A test that must exist before a step's implementation is accepted; derived mechanically from the graph.

flow:Transition.label: Transition
flow:Transition.definition: A directed edge from a step, taken on an outcome when its guard holds; may apply effects to run state.

flow:blocking.label: blocking
flow:blocking.definition: Whether a failure of the check stops the step: 'true', 'false', or an expression over run state that decides.

flow:carries.label: carries
flow:carries.definition: The domain concept whose instances the artifact holds. This is the one bridge from the flow to the dt: and rpt: vocabularies.

flow:checkId.label: check id
flow:checkId.definition: Identifier of the check, unique in its step (fidelity, overflow).

flow:checkKind.label: check kind
flow:checkKind.definition: How the check is evaluated: metric (a comparison over recorded metrics) | script | json_schema | file_exists.

flow:command.label: command
flow:command.definition: The command line that runs the step, for steps executed by a script.

flow:comparedTo.label: compared to
flow:comparedTo.definition: The configuration value the check compares its metrics against; changing it changes what passes.

flow:concerns.label: concerns
flow:concerns.definition: A domain concept the invariant constrains.

flow:decisionOption.label: decision option
flow:decisionOption.definition: A decision the person may record; each becomes an outcome of the step.

flow:enforcedBy.label: enforced by
flow:enforcedBy.definition: A check that fails when the invariant is broken.

flow:entrypoint.label: entrypoint
flow:entrypoint.definition: The step a run of the phase starts at.

flow:exists.label: exists
flow:exists.definition: Whether the script was found on disk when the graph was built.

flow:expression.label: expression
flow:expression.definition: What the check evaluates: a comparison over metrics and config, a script to run, a schema, or a path that must exist.

flow:fieldPath.label: field path
flow:fieldPath.definition: The path of the field inside the artifact (pages[].regions[].bbox).

flow:forStep.label: for step
flow:forStep.definition: The step whose implementation must pass the test.

flow:foreach.label: for each
flow:foreach.definition: The collection in run state the step runs once per item of (the documents of a batch, the stress cases).

flow:format.label: format
flow:format.definition: The file format of the artifact (json, png, pdf, folder…).

flow:guard.label: guard
flow:guard.definition: A condition over run state and config that must hold for the transition to be taken; absent means always.

flow:hasCheck.label: has check
flow:hasCheck.definition: A validation run after the step's action. The first failed blocking check sets the step's outcome.

flow:hasEffect.label: has effect
flow:hasEffect.definition: A change to run state applied when the transition is taken; effects apply in order.

flow:hasField.label: has field
flow:hasField.definition: A named path the artifact's content must contain. A JSON artifact with no fields is under-specified: an agent must not guess its structure.

flow:hasOutcome.label: has outcome
flow:hasOutcome.definition: A result the step can end with. Every outcome needs at least one transition.

flow:implementedBy.label: implemented by
flow:implementedBy.definition: The script that executes the step.

flow:inPhase.label: in phase
flow:inPhase.definition: The phase the step belongs to (template build, production run).

flow:isImplemented.label: is implemented
flow:isImplemented.definition: Whether the flow definition marks the step's action as implemented.

flow:measures.label: measures
flow:measures.definition: A metric the check's expression reads. The step must record it (flow:records).

flow:metricName.label: metric name
flow:metricName.definition: Name of the metric as it appears in run state under the step.

flow:obligationKind.label: obligation kind
flow:obligationKind.definition: The kind of test required: pass_case | fail_case | route | property.

flow:onFail.label: on fail
flow:onFail.definition: The outcome the step takes when this check fails and is blocking.

flow:onOutcome.label: on outcome
flow:onOutcome.definition: The outcome of the source step on which the transition is considered.

flow:op.label: operation
flow:op.definition: The kind of change: set | set_from | increment | reset | append | reactivate_items | exclude_failed_items.

flow:optional.label: optional
flow:optional.definition: True when the artifact need not exist for the flow to proceed.

flow:outcomeName.label: outcome name
flow:outcomeName.definition: Name of the outcome (pass, fail, approve, reject…); the only thing transitions branch on.

flow:outputSchema.label: output schema
flow:outputSchema.definition: The JSON Schema the output must satisfy: on a Claude step, the schema its answer is validated against; on an artifact, the schema of its content.

flow:paramName.label: parameter name
flow:paramName.definition: Name of the configuration value, as its path in the flow's config (claude.model, ssim_region_min_vector).

flow:path.label: path
flow:path.definition: Where the artifact, or the step's script, is found; may contain placeholders such as {run_dir} or {skill_dir}.

flow:priority.label: priority
flow:priority.definition: Order in which the transitions for one step and outcome are tried: ascending, and the first whose guard holds is taken.

flow:producedBy.label: produced by
flow:producedBy.definition: The step that creates the artifact.

flow:promptRef.label: prompt reference
flow:promptRef.definition: The prompt file the Claude step is invoked with.

flow:promptVersion.label: prompt version
flow:promptVersion.definition: Version of the prompt; part of the cache key, so a new version invalidates cached outputs.

flow:reads.label: reads
flow:reads.definition: An artifact the step needs as input; the step is blocked when it is missing.

flow:readsOptional.label: reads optional
flow:readsOptional.definition: An artifact the step uses when it is present and runs without when it is absent.

flow:readsStatePath.label: reads state path
flow:readsStatePath.definition: A path in run state that the guard, or the check, depends on.

flow:records.label: records
flow:records.definition: A measurement the step writes to run state, for its checks and for transition guards.

flow:requiredField.label: required field
flow:requiredField.definition: A field the recorded decision must carry (reviewer, comment…) before the flow continues.

flow:retryMax.label: retry maximum
flow:retryMax.definition: How many times the step is re-run on a retryable outcome before that outcome stands.

flow:reviewPage.label: review page
flow:reviewPage.definition: The page shown to the person who must decide.

flow:sourceRef.label: source reference
flow:sourceRef.definition: Where in the flow definition the fact came from (file#pointer), for traceability.

flow:statePath.label: state path
flow:statePath.definition: The path in run state the effect changes.

flow:statement.label: statement
flow:statement.definition: The invariant, stated in one sentence.

flow:stepId.label: step id
flow:stepId.definition: Identifier of the step, unique in its flow (B10_verify). Transitions, run state, briefs and code citations refer to a step by it.

flow:tests.label: tests
flow:tests.definition: What the required test exercises: a check (pass and fail case), a transition (route), or an invariant (property).

flow:to.label: to
flow:to.definition: The step the transition goes to.

flow:toDynamic.label: to (dynamic)
flow:toDynamic.definition: A target read from run state when the transition is taken, e.g. $state.context.resume_node; used in place of flow:to.

flow:usesOcr.label: uses OCR
flow:usesOcr.definition: True when the step runs an OCR engine as part of its work.

flow:usesParameter.label: uses parameter
flow:usesParameter.definition: A configuration value the step's action, or the transition's guard, depends on.

flow:value.label: value
flow:value.definition: On a parameter: its current value in config (JSON for lists and objects). On a flow: its version.

flow:writes.label: writes
flow:writes.definition: An artifact the step produces as output.

flow:writesOnly.label: writes only
flow:writesOnly.definition: A path the Claude step may write to; anything written outside the listed paths fails the scope check.

meta:alternatives.label: alternatives
meta:alternatives.definition: What was considered instead, and why it was rejected.

meta:rationale.label: rationale
meta:rationale.definition: Why the term, shape or question exists: which question could not be answered, or what would go wrong, without it.

meta:validatedBy.label: validated by
meta:validatedBy.definition: The person who knows the domain and confirmed the term, shape or question as written. Left absent until a person has; never filled in by an agent.

meta:validatedOn.label: validated on
meta:validatedOn.definition: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the confirmation. It covers the text as it stood that day: a later change to the meaning asks for a new confirmation.

rpt:Approval.label: Approval
rpt:Approval.definition: A recorded human decision at a gate of a run: reviewer, decision, time, hashes reviewed. [CQ3]

rpt:ApprovalPolicy.label: Approval policy
rpt:ApprovalPolicy.definition: How much human review a production batch gets: sample rate and minimum, full review after a new release, reviewer role. [CQ11]

rpt:Change.label: Change
rpt:Change.definition: One fact of a definition that a revision added, changed or removed, named by its file and path (semantic/lineage.yaml → fields.mer.column), with its value before and after. [CQ20, CQ21]
rpt:Change.rationale: A revision without its facts says that something changed, not what; questions about one field's history need the fact itself.

rpt:Column.label: Column
rpt:Column.definition: A column of a table. A field is mapped to the one column that supplies its value: the value itself for a single-valued field, JSON text for a structured field. A parameter is bound to the column that selects one document's rows. [CQ5-7]

rpt:DataSource.label: Data source
rpt:DataSource.definition: A database the analyst names as the origin of a report's data: a connection name, a kind (bigquery, sqlite…) and a database. Endpoints and credentials are environment config, never here. [CQ7]

rpt:Field.label: Field
rpt:Field.definition: A piece of information the report shows, with a type, at least one meaning per locale, optional rules, and the column that supplies it. The semantic counterpart of a template slot. [CQ1, CQ4-6, CQ8-9, CQ15, CQ18]

rpt:FieldMeaning.label: Field meaning
rpt:FieldMeaning.definition: The label and definition of a field in one locale. [CQ1]

rpt:ObservabilityPolicy.label: Observability policy
rpt:ObservabilityPolicy.definition: What a production run of a release is expected to achieve and who hears about it when it does not: delivery deadline, tolerated failure rate, alert recipients, and where the run history is recorded. The history itself lives in that log, not in this graph. [CQ17]

rpt:Parameter.label: Parameter
rpt:Parameter.definition: A value that identifies one document of a report type (fund id, series, as-of month, locale). [CQ2]

rpt:PublishPolicy.label: Publish policy
rpt:PublishPolicy.definition: Where produced documents go: path pattern over the parameters, formats, retention. Endpoints are environment config, not here. [CQ12]

rpt:ReportType.label: Report type
rpt:ReportType.definition: A family of documents sharing one purpose, one set of sections and fields, one table and one template folder; identified by id and version. [CQ1-19]

rpt:Revision.label: Revision
rpt:Revision.definition: One accepted revision of a report type's definition: who accepted it, when it was recorded, from which date it applies, why, and the facts it changed. The first revision holds the whole definition as first accepted; revisions are appended and never rewritten, so replaying them gives the definition as it stood on any date. [CQ20, CQ21]
rpt:Revision.rationale: Without it a corrected meaning or column overwrites the old one, and 'what did this report say when that document was produced' has no answer. Compliance asks exactly that.
rpt:Revision.alternatives: Relying on git history of the YAML files: rejected because the graph and its consumers cannot query it, it records who committed rather than who accepted, and it has no reason or effective date.

rpt:Rule.label: Rule
rpt:Rule.definition: A constraint or regulatory requirement on a field or report (sums to 100%, must carry disclaimer, not annualized under one year). [CQ4]

rpt:Run.label: Run
rpt:Run.definition: One execution of the template-build flow: which flow and engine version, which source documents it used, which steps ran, what it produced. [CQ3]

rpt:Schedule.label: Schedule
rpt:Schedule.definition: When documents of a release are produced: cadence, day within the cadence, as-of rule, business calendar, timezone. Declared in the release manifest; the dispatcher reads it, nothing else holds it. [CQ10]

rpt:Section.label: Section
rpt:Section.definition: A named part of the report with one purpose, rendered by one component, holding an ordered set of fields; may be present only in some layouts. [CQ2, CQ8]

rpt:StatusChange.label: Status change
rpt:StatusChange.definition: One step in the lifecycle of a report type: the status it reached, who recorded the step and when. Steps are appended as the work progresses and never rewritten; the last one is the report's current status. [CQ19]

rpt:Table.label: Table
rpt:Table.definition: A table of a data source, identified by dataset and name. A report type reads one table that holds every column it needs; how that table is populated belongs to the data team's own lineage, which joins to this graph on the same names. [CQ5-7]

rpt:UniverseQuery.label: Universe query
rpt:UniverseQuery.definition: A named query (lineage.yaml → queries) that lists the allowed values of a parameter at run time, e.g. active funds. [CQ12]

rpt:VerificationPolicy.label: Verification policy
rpt:VerificationPolicy.definition: Thresholds a produced document must meet in a production run: static-region similarity to golden images, overflow, fidelity. [CQ11]

rpt:alertRecipient.label: alert recipient
rpt:alertRecipient.definition: A role or channel told when a run misses its deadline or exceeds its failure rate; one value per recipient. Addresses are environment config, not here.

rpt:alias.label: alias
rpt:alias.definition: Another name readers use for the field (management expense ratio for mer, frais de gestion); one value per name. Lets a question in the reader's words find the field, and a new report reuse it instead of inventing a second id.
rpt:alias.rationale: Field ids are snake_case and labels are short (MER); analysts and data teams ask with the long name or the other language, and without aliases the same information gets a second field id.

rpt:allowedValue.label: allowed value
rpt:allowedValue.definition: A value the parameter may take, when the values are enumerated in the manifest; one per value.

rpt:asOfRule.label: as-of rule
rpt:asOfRule.definition: Which date the data is taken at, relative to the run: prev_month_end | prev_quarter_end | prev_year_end | run_date | prev_business_day.

rpt:assetPending.label: asset pending
rpt:assetPending.definition: An asset the release still lacks (logo, licensed font); one value per asset.

rpt:at.label: at
rpt:at.definition: When the decision, the status change or the revision was recorded: an ISO 8601 date or date-time.

rpt:audience.label: audience
rpt:audience.definition: A group of readers the report is written for (investors, advisors, compliance); one value per group.

rpt:boundBy.label: bound by
rpt:boundBy.definition: What supplies the parameter's value at run time when it is not enumerated: schedule | batch_spec.

rpt:boundToColumn.label: bound to column
rpt:boundToColumn.definition: The column whose value must equal the parameter's value to select the rows of one document.

rpt:cadence.label: cadence
rpt:cadence.definition: How often documents are produced: daily | weekly | monthly | quarterly | semi_annual | annual | on_demand. On a schedule it is the operating value; on a report type it is informative.

rpt:calendar.label: calendar
rpt:calendar.definition: The business calendar that decides which days are business days (TSX, NYSE…).

rpt:changeKind.label: change kind
rpt:changeKind.definition: What the revision did to the fact: added | changed | removed.

rpt:changedBy.label: changed by
rpt:changedBy.definition: The person who recorded the status change (who started the definition, who put it in validation, who deployed it to production), or who accepted the revision of the definition.

rpt:columnName.label: column name
rpt:columnName.definition: Name of the column in its table.

rpt:compiledAt.label: compiled at
rpt:compiledAt.definition: When semantic.py compiled this report's graph from its files.

rpt:database.label: database
rpt:database.definition: The database (or cloud project) inside the data source that holds the report's dataset.

rpt:dataset.label: dataset
rpt:dataset.definition: The dataset or schema the table sits in.

rpt:decision.label: decision
rpt:decision.definition: What the reviewer decided (approve, reject, revise…).

rpt:definition.label: definition
rpt:definition.definition: What the field means, in the locale of the field meaning; or what the parameter identifies.

rpt:deliverWithinHours.label: deliver within hours
rpt:deliverWithinHours.definition: The delivery deadline: hours after the scheduled start by which every approved document must be published. A run that misses it raises an alert.

rpt:derivedFrom.label: derived from
rpt:derivedFrom.definition: The sample PDF the analyst provided, which the report's template reproduces.

rpt:effectiveFrom.label: effective from
rpt:effectiveFrom.definition: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which the revision applies. Usually the day it was recorded (rpt:at); earlier for a correction that applies retroactively, later for a change planned for a future run.
rpt:effectiveFrom.rationale: When a fact was recorded and when it became true differ: a mapping fixed today may have been wrong since last month's run. As-of questions read this date.

rpt:engineVersion.label: engine version
rpt:engineVersion.definition: On a run: the engine that executed it. On a release: the engine it was frozen with; a production run refuses another major.minor.

rpt:fact.label: fact
rpt:fact.definition: The fact that changed, named by the file and the path where it is written, the way gaps and explain name it: semantic/report.yaml → fields.mer.meaning.

rpt:fidelityMin.label: fidelity minimum
rpt:fidelityMin.definition: Lowest accepted share of data values found unchanged in the produced document.

rpt:fieldId.label: field id
rpt:fieldId.definition: Identifier of the field, unique in its report: the snake_case form of its English label. By convention the column that supplies it has the same name; the column actually used is the one rpt:sourcedFrom points at. Two reports that use the same field id show the same information (CQ9, CQ15).

rpt:fieldType.label: field type
rpt:fieldType.definition: How the value is shaped and formatted. Single-valued: text | enum | number | integer | percent | currency | date | boolean. Structured, stored as JSON text in the field's column: list | grouped_list | series | list_of_text | currency_pair | percent_by_series.

rpt:fileHash.label: file hash
rpt:fileHash.definition: Every released file and its fingerprint, as JSON: path → sha256.

rpt:flow.label: flow
rpt:flow.definition: Identifier of the flow the run executed.

rpt:flowVersion.label: flow version
rpt:flowVersion.definition: Version of the flow definition the run executed.

rpt:font.label: font
rpt:font.definition: The fonts the release needs, as JSON: family, file, license, sha256, and the source font each stands in for.

rpt:frozen.label: frozen
rpt:frozen.definition: True once the release is signed off and can no longer change; only frozen releases run in production.

rpt:fullReviewAfterRelease.label: full review after release
rpt:fullReviewAfterRelease.definition: True when the first batch after a new template release is reviewed in full.

rpt:gate.label: gate
rpt:gate.definition: The human step of the flow at which the decision was taken.

rpt:goldenStaticSsimMin.label: golden static SSIM minimum
rpt:goldenStaticSsimMin.definition: Lowest accepted similarity between the static regions of a produced document and the golden image; below it the document fails.

rpt:hasApproval.label: has approval
rpt:hasApproval.definition: A human decision recorded at a gate of the run.

rpt:hasApprovalPolicy.label: has approval policy
rpt:hasApprovalPolicy.definition: How much human review a production batch of the release gets before publishing.

rpt:hasChange.label: has change
rpt:hasChange.definition: A fact the revision added, changed or removed.

rpt:hasMeaning.label: has meaning
rpt:hasMeaning.definition: The label and definition of the field in one locale; one per locale the report is offered in.

rpt:hasObservabilityPolicy.label: has observability policy
rpt:hasObservabilityPolicy.definition: What a production run of the release is expected to achieve, who is alerted when it does not, and where its history is recorded.

rpt:hasParameter.label: has parameter
rpt:hasParameter.definition: From a report type: a value that identifies one of its documents, with its meaning. From a template release: the same parameter, with where its allowed values come from at that version.

rpt:hasPublishPolicy.label: has publish policy
rpt:hasPublishPolicy.definition: Where the produced documents of the release go, in which formats, and for how long they are kept.

rpt:hasRevision.label: has revision
rpt:hasRevision.definition: An accepted revision of the report type's definition. Together they are its history: what the definition said, and since when.

rpt:hasRule.label: has rule
rpt:hasRule.definition: A constraint or regulatory requirement that applies to the field, or to the report as a whole.

rpt:hasSchedule.label: has schedule
rpt:hasSchedule.definition: When documents of the release are produced.

rpt:hasSection.label: has section
rpt:hasSection.definition: The report type is made of this section.

rpt:hasStatusChange.label: has status change
rpt:hasStatusChange.definition: A step in the report type's lifecycle. Together the steps are its history: when it was started, saved, put in validation and deployed, and by whom.

rpt:hasUniverseQuery.label: has universe query
rpt:hasUniverseQuery.definition: A named query the report type declares, which a parameter can point at for its allowed values.

rpt:hasVerificationPolicy.label: has verification policy
rpt:hasVerificationPolicy.definition: The thresholds every produced document of the release must meet.

rpt:inDataSource.label: in data source
rpt:inDataSource.definition: The data source the table lives in.

rpt:inReport.label: in report
rpt:inReport.definition: The report type the field belongs to. Stated directly on the field so fields can be compared across reports (CQ9, CQ15).

rpt:inSection.label: in section
rpt:inSection.definition: The one section that shows the field.

rpt:inTable.label: in table
rpt:inTable.definition: The table the column belongs to.

rpt:kind.label: kind
rpt:kind.definition: The family the report type belongs to (fund-fact-sheet, statement…); used to group the catalogue.

rpt:label.label: label
rpt:label.definition: On a field meaning: the text the report shows for the field in that locale (English or French). On a parameter: its name. Names of other nodes use rdfs:label.

rpt:layout.label: layout
rpt:layout.definition: The named arrangement of components the report type uses (layouts.json of its template folder).

rpt:libraryVersion.label: library version
rpt:libraryVersion.definition: Version of the shared component library the release's templates were built against.

rpt:lifecycleStatus.label: lifecycle status
rpt:lifecycleStatus.definition: Where a report type is in its lifecycle: inception (its definition has been started) | saved (the definition validates and is part of the catalogue graph) | in_validation (the definition and its template are being checked by agents and a person) | in_production (documents are produced from a frozen release). On a status change: the status that step reached. On a report type: its current status, the one of its latest step.

rpt:lineageNote.label: lineage note
rpt:lineageNote.definition: A remark on the field's mapping: why it is unmapped, who owns the content, what remains to confirm.

rpt:lineageStatus.label: lineage status
rpt:lineageStatus.definition: How far the field's mapping has got: unmapped (no column known) | proposed (suggested, not yet confirmed) | verified (confirmed by the analyst). Unmapped fields block a production release.

rpt:locale.label: locale
rpt:locale.definition: A language code (en, fr): on a report type, a language it is offered in; on a field meaning, the language of that meaning.

rpt:maxFailureRate.label: maximum failure rate
rpt:maxFailureRate.definition: Share of a batch's documents, between 0 and 1, that may fail verification before the run raises an alert.

rpt:members.label: members
rpt:members.definition: For a composite field (risk measures), its named members and the definition of each, as JSON.

rpt:newValue.label: new value
rpt:newValue.definition: The value the fact holds from the revision on: text as written, any other value as JSON. Absent when the fact was removed.

rpt:note.label: note
rpt:note.definition: A free remark on a source document, a universe query or a status change.

rpt:ofReport.label: of report
rpt:ofReport.definition: The report type a template release belongs to.

rpt:ontologyVersion.label: ontology version
rpt:ontologyVersion.definition: The version of this ontology the release's semantic layer was written for, or the report's graph was compiled against.

rpt:order.label: order
rpt:order.definition: Position of a section in the report, of a field in its section, of a status change in the report's lifecycle, or of a revision in the history of its definition, starting at 1.

rpt:overflowBlocking.label: overflow blocking
rpt:overflowBlocking.definition: True when any content overflowing its box fails the document.

rpt:owner.label: owner
rpt:owner.definition: The report analyst responsible for the report's definition and for verifying its field-to-column mapping.

rpt:pageKind.label: page kind
rpt:pageKind.definition: How each page of the source document is encoded, one value per page: vector | raster | mixed.

rpt:pathPattern.label: path pattern
rpt:pathPattern.definition: Destination path of a published document, as a pattern over the parameters and {template_id}.

rpt:presentWhen.label: present when
rpt:presentWhen.definition: Layout condition under which the section appears; absent means always present.

rpt:previousValue.label: previous value
rpt:previousValue.definition: The value the fact held before the revision: text as written, any other value as JSON. Absent when the fact was added.

rpt:producedBy.label: produced by
rpt:producedBy.definition: The run of the template-build flow that produced the release.

rpt:publishFormat.label: publish format
rpt:publishFormat.definition: A format the document is published in: pdf | png | html; one value per format.

rpt:purpose.label: purpose
rpt:purpose.definition: What the report, or the section, is for: the question it answers for its reader.

rpt:readsTable.label: reads table
rpt:readsTable.definition: The table the analyst named for the report: it holds every column the report needs, and the rows of one document are selected by the parameter columns.

rpt:reason.label: reason
rpt:reason.definition: Why the revision was accepted: what was wrong or missing before. Required whenever a revision changes or removes a fact.
rpt:reason.rationale: Supersession without a reason tells the reader that a value changed but not whether the old one was wrong or merely out of date.

rpt:receivedOn.label: received on
rpt:receivedOn.definition: The date the analyst provided the source document.

rpt:referenceKind.label: reference kind
rpt:referenceKind.definition: What the fidelity gate compared the render against: vector | raster. A raster reference caps the fidelity that can be claimed.

rpt:regulatory.label: regulatory
rpt:regulatory.definition: True when the rule comes from regulation or compliance and not from presentation choices.

rpt:releasedAs.label: released as
rpt:releasedAs.definition: The versioned template folder that renders documents of the report type, with its operating contract.

rpt:renderedBy.label: rendered by
rpt:renderedBy.definition: The component (one template macro of the shared library) that draws the section. Reports that use the same component are affected together when it changes (CQ16).

rpt:repoUrl.label: repository URL
rpt:repoUrl.definition: Where the source PDF, or the template folder, is stored in a repository.

rpt:reportId.label: report id
rpt:reportId.definition: Identifier of the report type (lower case, hyphens). The template folder, the manifest's template_id and, by convention, the report's table carry the same name.

rpt:result.label: result
rpt:result.definition: Where the run ended: draft | signed_off | frozen.

rpt:retentionDays.label: retention days
rpt:retentionDays.definition: How many days a published document is kept.

rpt:returnsParameter.label: returns parameter
rpt:returnsParameter.definition: Name of the parameter whose values the query returns.

rpt:reviewedHash.label: reviewed hash
rpt:reviewedHash.definition: What the reviewer saw, as JSON: path → sha256 of each file reviewed.

rpt:reviewer.label: reviewer
rpt:reviewer.definition: The person who took the decision.

rpt:reviewerRole.label: reviewer role
rpt:reviewerRole.definition: The role that must approve a batch before it is published.

rpt:role.label: role
rpt:role.definition: What the source document is used for: primary (the one the template reproduces) | alternate | reference.

rpt:rowStructure.label: row structure
rpt:rowStructure.definition: For list-like fields, the shape of one row as JSON: member name → type and meaning. The field's column holds the list as JSON text: an array of rows of this shape.

rpt:ruleText.label: rule text
rpt:ruleText.definition: The rule, stated in one sentence.

rpt:runLog.label: run log
rpt:runLog.definition: Where each run of the release records its history (start, end, documents produced, failed, published): a table or path. The graph points at the log; it does not hold the history.

rpt:runOn.label: run on
rpt:runOn.definition: The day within the cadence on which the run starts: business_day:N | calendar_day:N | weekday:N | on_demand.

rpt:sampleMin.label: sample minimum
rpt:sampleMin.definition: Smallest number of documents shown to the reviewer, whatever the sample rate gives.

rpt:sampleRate.label: sample rate
rpt:sampleRate.definition: Share of a batch's documents shown to the reviewer, between 0 and 1.

rpt:sha256.label: sha256
rpt:sha256.definition: On a source document: the fingerprint that identifies it. On a template release: the fingerprint of each source document it was built from.

rpt:sourceKind.label: source kind
rpt:sourceKind.definition: The database technology of the data source (bigquery, sqlite, postgres…); tells the loader which dialect and connection to use.

rpt:sourcedFrom.label: sourced from
rpt:sourcedFrom.definition: The column that supplies the field's value. This is the mapping: the agent proposes it, the analyst verifies it (rpt:lineageStatus).

rpt:sql.label: sql
rpt:sql.definition: The query text that returns the allowed values.

rpt:step.label: step
rpt:step.definition: The steps that ran, as JSON: step id, tool or prompt@version, outputs, metrics.

rpt:tableName.label: table name
rpt:tableName.definition: Name of the table. By convention the report's table takes the report's name.

rpt:timezone.label: timezone
rpt:timezone.definition: The timezone the schedule's days and times are read in (IANA name).

rpt:universeQuery.label: universe query
rpt:universeQuery.definition: The query that lists the parameter's allowed values at run time. Written in the manifest as lineage:queries.<name>.

rpt:usedSource.label: used source
rpt:usedSource.definition: A source document the run read as input.

rpt:version.label: version
rpt:version.definition: Semantic version: of the report type's definition, or of the template release.

rpt:waiver.label: waiver
rpt:waiver.definition: A named exception accepted at sign-off, for instance when the reference is not vector.

sparql 3fbdc13e19.sh:select: PREFIX rpt: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/report#> SELECT $this WHERE { $this rpt:changeKind ?k . FILTER(?k IN ("changed", "removed")) FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:previousValue ?v } }
sparql 3fbdc13e19.sh:message: A changed or removed fact does not keep the value it had before (CQ21)

report-shapes.ttl#Change.rationale: The value before is the whole point of supersession: without it the history says that a fact changed but not what was true.

property rpt:inTable.sh:message: Column not attached to exactly one table (CQ6)

property rpt:sourceKind.sh:message: Data source has no kind: the loader cannot choose a connection (CQ7)

property rpt:sourcedFrom.sh:message: Field is mapped to more than one column (CQ5)

property rpt:inSection.sh:message: Field must sit in exactly one section

property rpt:hasMeaning.sh:message: Field has no meaning in any locale (CQ1)

sparql 6d3de06159.sh:select: PREFIX rpt: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/report#> SELECT $this WHERE { FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:hasMeaning ?m . ?m rpt:locale "en" ; rpt:definition ?d } }

sparql 4f8e044bca.sh:select: PREFIX rpt: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/report#> SELECT $this WHERE { $this rpt:lineageStatus ?s . FILTER(?s IN ("proposed","verified")) FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:sourcedFrom ?x } }
sparql 4f8e044bca.sh:message: Mapping says proposed/verified but no column is attached (CQ5)

sparql 1b47340f3f.sh:select: PREFIX rpt: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/report#> SELECT $this WHERE { $this rpt:sourcedFrom ?c ; rpt:inReport ?r . ?c rpt:inTable ?t . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?r rpt:readsTable ?t } }
sparql 1b47340f3f.sh:message: Field is mapped to a column outside the report's table (CQ5, CQ7)

sparql e81dd85814.sh:select: PREFIX rpt: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/report#> SELECT $this WHERE { $this rpt:inReport ?r . ?r rpt:locale "fr" . FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:hasMeaning ?m . ?m rpt:locale "fr" } }
sparql e81dd85814.sh:message: Field has no French meaning although the report is offered in fr

property rpt:lineageStatus.sh:message: Field not mapped to a column (blocks production release)

sparql 35719b17c4.sh:select: PREFIX rpt: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/report#> SELECT $this WHERE { $this rpt:frozen true . FILTER( NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:hasSchedule ?s } || NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:hasVerificationPolicy ?v } || NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:hasApprovalPolicy ?a } || NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:hasPublishPolicy ?p } || NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:hasObservabilityPolicy ?ob } || NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:hasParameter ?q } || NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:engineVersion ?e } || NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:ontologyVersion ?o } || NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:libraryVersion ?l } ) }
sparql 35719b17c4.sh:message: Frozen release lacks part of its operating contract (schedule, policies, observability, parameters, engine/ontology/library version)

property rpt:maxFailureRate.sh:message: Observability policy has no failure rate between 0 and 1 (CQ17)

property rpt:runLog.sh:message: Observability policy does not say where the run history is recorded (CQ17)

property rpt:deliverWithinHours.sh:message: Observability policy has no delivery deadline (CQ17)

sparql 2bab56c7c9.sh:select: PREFIX rpt: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/report#> SELECT $this WHERE { FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:universeQuery ?u } FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:allowedValue ?v } FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:boundBy ?b } }
sparql 2bab56c7c9.sh:message: Parameter has no universe (query, values or run-time binding): the dispatcher cannot expand a batch (CQ12)

property rpt:hasObservabilityPolicy.sh:message: Release declares no observability policy (CQ17; blocks production)

property rpt:hasSchedule.sh:message: Release declares no schedule (CQ10; blocks production)

property rpt:readsTable.sh:message: Report does not name exactly one table (CQ7; blocks production release)

property rpt:hasRevision.sh:message: Report has no accepted revision: its definition can change without a record (CQ20; blocks production)

report-shapes.ttl#ReportHistory.rationale: A warning, not a violation: reports written before 2.1.0 have no history yet and must keep compiling until someone accepts their definition.

property rpt:lifecycleStatus.sh:message: Report does not carry exactly one lifecycle status (CQ19)

sparql 68c18550ff.sh:select: PREFIX rpt: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/report#> SELECT $this WHERE { $this rpt:lifecycleStatus "in_production" . FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this rpt:releasedAs ?rel . ?rel rpt:frozen true } }
sparql 68c18550ff.sh:message: Report is in production but its release is not frozen: only a frozen release produces documents (CQ19)

property rpt:at.sh:message: Revision does not say when it was recorded (CQ20)

property rpt:changedBy.sh:message: Revision does not say who accepted it (CQ20)

property rpt:reason.sh:message: Revision does not say why it was accepted (CQ20)

report-shapes.ttl#Revision.rationale: A revision nobody can attribute or explain is an overwrite with extra steps.

property rpt:renderedBy.sh:message: Section not bound to a component (CQ8)

property rpt:sha256.sh:message: Source document has no real sha256

property rpt:at.sh:message: Status change does not say when it was recorded (CQ19)

property rpt:changedBy.sh:message: Status change does not say who recorded it (CQ19)

property rpt:inDataSource.sh:message: Table is not attached to a data source (CQ7)

property rpt:goldenStaticSsimMin.sh:message: Static-region SSIM threshold below 0.9 defeats the golden check

property flow:carries.sh:message: Artifact is not bound to a domain concept

sparql d07e36512c.sh:select: PREFIX flow: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/flow#> SELECT $this WHERE { ?step flow:writes $this . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?step a flow:HumanStep } $this flow:format ?f . FILTER(?f IN ("json","json-schema")) FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this flow:hasField ?x } }
sparql d07e36512c.sh:message: JSON artifact written by an automated step has no field specification

sparql 391b17c0c7.sh:select: PREFIX flow: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/flow#> SELECT $this WHERE { $this flow:checkKind "metric" . FILTER NOT EXISTS { $this flow:measures ?m } }

sparql 13ef918164.sh:select: PREFIX flow: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/flow#> SELECT $this ?name WHERE { ?step flow:hasCheck $this . $this flow:measures ?m . ?m flow:metricName ?name . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?step flow:records ?m } }
sparql 13ef918164.sh:message: Check reads a metric its step does not declare as recorded: {?name}

property flow:hasCheck.sh:message: Claude output must be gated by at least one deterministic check

property flow:writesOnly.sh:message: Claude step has no declared write scope

property flow:enforcedBy.sh:message: Invariant is not enforced by any check

sparql 445fb84dbc.sh:select: PREFIX flow: <https://cynergis.ai/ont/flow#> SELECT $this WHERE { FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?t flow:onOutcome $this } }
sparql 445fb84dbc.sh:message: Outcome has no outgoing transition (the run would get stuck)

property flow:value.sh:message: Parameter referenced but not defined in config

property flow:command.sh:message: Script step has no command contract

CQ1.question: What does field $FIELD mean, and what is its label in each locale?

CQ2.question: Which sections and fields make up report $REPORT, in order, and which are layout-dependent?

CQ3.question: Which source document, run and approvals produced the template of report $REPORT?

CQ4.question: Which fields of report $REPORT carry rules, and which rules are regulatory?

CQ5.question: Which column of which table supplies each field of report $REPORT, is the column a single value or JSON, and which fields are still unmapped?

CQ6.question: If column $COLUMN changes, which reports and fields are affected?

CQ7.question: Which data source and table does report $REPORT read, and which column carries each parameter?

CQ8.question: Which component renders field $FIELD, in which template release?

CQ10.question: When does report $REPORT run — cadence, day, as-of rule, calendar, timezone — and at which template version?

CQ11.question: What verification thresholds and approval policy govern production runs of report $REPORT?

CQ12.question: What identifies one document of report $REPORT, where do the allowed values of each parameter come from, and where is the document published?

CQ13.question: What does the release of report $REPORT need to render — engine, ontology and library versions, fonts, files, pending assets, waivers?

CQ14.question: Which report types exist — what is each for, where is it in its lifecycle, how often does it run, who owns it, and which template version is released?

CQ15.question: Which other reports show the same fields as report $REPORT, and which fields do they share?

CQ16.question: Which report types use component $COMPONENT, and in which sections?

CQ17.question: What is expected of each run of report $REPORT — delivery deadline and tolerated failures — who is alerted, and where is the run history?

CQ18.question: Which fields does the catalogue already define — id, type, English label, definition and the other names readers use — and how many reports use each?

CQ19.question: Where is report $REPORT in its lifecycle — inception, saved to the graph, in validation, in production — and who recorded each step, when?

CQ20.question: How has the definition of report $REPORT changed — each accepted revision, who accepted it, when, from which date it applies, why, and which facts it added, changed or removed?
CQ20.why: A definition that is corrected in place loses what was true when earlier documents were produced; compliance must be able to show it, with who decided and why.

CQ21.question: Has anything about field $FIELD changed in any report — its meaning, label, type or column — what was it before, when, who accepted the change, and why?
CQ21.why: Before reusing a field or trusting a figure, an analyst needs to know whether its meaning or its column moved, and since when.

flow:CQ01.question: What is this step for, and what kind of executor runs it?

flow:CQ02.question: Which artifacts does it read and write, where, in what format?

flow:CQ03.question: What structure (fields) must each JSON artifact it writes have?

flow:CQ04.question: Which checks gate this step: what does each measure, against which threshold, and what happens on failure?

flow:CQ05.question: Which metrics must the step record in state (and are all checked metrics recorded)?

flow:CQ06.question: Which configuration parameters does the step depend on, and their current values?

flow:CQ07.question: Which domain invariants does this step enforce?

flow:CQ08.question: How is the step executed (command, Claude prompt, or human review), and does an implementation exist?

flow:CQ09.question: Which later steps consume what this step writes (field names must match)?

flow:CQ10.question: Which domain concepts do its inputs and outputs carry, and what do they mean?

flow:CQ11.question: For each outcome, which transition fires, under which guard, and where does it go?

flow:CQ12.question: Which tests must exist for this step (derived mechanically from checks, transitions and invariants)?

flow:CQ13.question: Which state paths and config parameters do transition guards read?

flow:CQ14.question: What must every human step record before the flow can continue?

flow:CQ15.question: Which steps have no implementation yet?

flow:CQ16.question: If this parameter changes, which checks, transitions and tests are affected?

flow:CQ17.question: If this artifact's structure changes, who writes it, who reads it, which checks touch it?
